queryList.query: MATCH (u)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource)-[t:TargetsUser]->(target:User) WHERE res.class = 'SURROGAT' RETURN u, r, res, t, target
MATCH (u)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource)-[t:TargetsUser]->(target:User) WHERE res.class = 'UNIXPRIV' RETURN u, r, res, t, target
MATCH (u:User)-[r:MemberOf]->(g:Group) RETURN u, r, g
MATCH (sg:Group)-[r:SubGroupOf]->(pg:Group) RETURN sg, r, pg
MATCH (n)-[r:MemberOf|SubGroupOf]->(g:Group) RETURN n, r, g

queries.name: RACF - SURROGAT Chain (User -> Profile -> Target User)

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource)-[t:TargetsUser]->(target:User) WHERE res.class = 'SURROGAT' RETURN u, r, res, t, target

queries.name: RACF - Users with SURROGAT Access to Privileged Users

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource)-[t:TargetsUser]->(target:User) WHERE res.class = 'SURROGAT' AND (res.name CONTAINS 'ADMIN' OR res.name CONTAINS 'SYS' OR res.name CONTAINS 'IBMUSER') RETURN u, r, res, t, target
MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.revoked = true RETURN u
MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.attributes CONTAINS 'SPECIAL' RETURN u
MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.attributes CONTAINS 'OPERATIONS' RETURN u
MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.attributes CONTAINS 'AUDITOR' RETURN u

queries.name: RACF - All Highly Privileged Users (SPECIAL or OPERATIONS)

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.attributes CONTAINS 'SPECIAL' OR u.attributes CONTAINS 'OPERATIONS' RETURN u

queries.name: RACF - Users with No Group Membership

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE NOT (u)-[:MemberOf]->(:Group) RETURN u

queries.name: RACF - All Relationships for a Specific User

queryList.title: Select a User
queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.name ORDER BY u.name
MATCH (u:User {name: $result})-[r]-(n) RETURN u, r, n

queries.name: RACF - All Members and Subgroups of a Specific Group

queryList.title: Select a Group
queryList.query: MATCH (g:Group) RETURN g.name ORDER BY g.name
MATCH (n)-[r:MemberOf|SubGroupOf]->(g:Group {name: $result}) RETURN n, r, g
MATCH (u)-[r:HasDatasetAccess]->(d:Dataset) RETURN u, r, d
MATCH (u)-[r:HasDatasetAccess]->(d:Dataset) WHERE r.access = 'ALTER' RETURN u, r, d

queries.name: RACF - Datasets with Public UACC (Not NONE)

queryList.query: MATCH (d:Dataset) WHERE d.uacc <> 'NONE' RETURN d ORDER BY d.uacc

queries.name: RACF - All Dataset Access for a Specific User

queryList.title: Select a User
queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.name ORDER BY u.name
MATCH (u:User {name: $result})-[r:HasDatasetAccess]->(d:Dataset) RETURN u, r, d

queries.name: RACF - All Users with Access to a Specific Dataset

queryList.title: Select a Dataset
queryList.query: MATCH (d:Dataset) RETURN d.name ORDER BY d.name
MATCH (u)-[r:HasDatasetAccess]->(d:Dataset {name: $result}) RETURN u, r, d
